new_theorem.name: NM10-AVP3-SPECTRAL-VARIANCE-STABILITY-15
new_theorem.summary: Exact stability identity for the sharp semigroup Hessian contraction. The defect is p(p-2) times an integrated spectral variance of sqrt(A); it enters the stochastic maximal-regularity inequality as an additional positive gap. This yields a data-dependent extrapolation bound and quantitative rigidity: near-sharp subcritical responses concentrate, in weighted spacetime average, inside three adjacent dyadic spectral blocks.
new_theorem.quantile_refinement: for ell=log(T/s)>=6, p=3-3/ell: s^(1/3)F*(s) <= 8 ell/(3+kappa_p ell) ||Y||_3
new_theorem.packet_rigidity: for 5/2<=p<3, weighted distance^2 to the best three-adjacent-dyadic-block packet is <= (2/c_*) kappa_p, c_*=5(3-2sqrt(2))/24
new_theorem.half_sharp_corollary: if R_p(Y)>=R_p^*/2 then weighted packet leakage <=70(3-p)

demonstrated_mechanism_gain: The exact blow-up mechanism is now stable: the only way to remain near the sharp (3-p)^(-1) subcritical norm is to have vanishing integrated spectral variance and hence local concentration in a three-block comparable spectral packet. Conversely, any variance-rich branch with kappa_p >= c ell^(-2/3) already satisfies the critical ell^(2/3) quantile scale. Together with the preceding finite-band and Hellinger results, the unresolved mechanism is reduced to adaptive migration of narrow spectral packets across unboundedly many dyadic scales while forcing is active.
failed_or_nonclosing_routes: The variance refinement alone does not close alpha=2/3 because exact one-shell states have zero defect; the already-proved shell endpoint must be combined with a packet-migration estimate.
A uniform best-N decay for arbitrary L^3 inputs is impossible without using dynamics, so the previous N-term remainder cannot be improved by approximation theory alone.
next_attack: Prove an active packet-migration Carleson estimate: charge changes of the three-block packet center using the critical Hellinger/decoherence kernel and cubic input energy. A summable migration charge would combine the variance-rich branch with the comparable-band endpoint and close the full Z_{3,2/3} bound.
